input.quote: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 imposes a one-way restrictive covenant on us: it runs 18 months post-termination, covers any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term (not just personnel involved in the Services), bars "engage" as well as solicit (an effective no-hire), and contains no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. It also sits uneasily with § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no no-hire commitment and may hire persons responding to general recruitment. Preferred position is no non-solicit on the Customer; given the parties' existing bargain in § 12.3 we have taken the fallback and narrowed § 12.4 to a mutual, 12-month, solicitation-only restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with advertising and inbound carve-outs and express deletion of any no-hire.

proposal.summary: Narrow Customer-only 18-month non-solicit/no-engage to a mutual 12-month solicitation-only restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept non-solicits that bind only us, cover every Vendor employee and bar engagement as well as solicitation, so we have narrowed § 12.4 to a mutual, 12-month restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches. This also removes the effective no-hire, which conflicts with § 12.3; our preferred position remains no non-solicit on us.

ops.oldText: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
ops.newText: 12.4 During the term and for twelve months after the end of a person's involvement in the Services, neither party will solicit for employment any personnel of the other party who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. Nothing in this Section restricts either party from (a) hiring or engaging any person who responds to a general advertisement or other recruitment effort not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or (b) hiring or engaging any person who approaches it on an unsolicited basis, and neither party is subject to any no-hire obligation.
